input_messages.content: Hi there. My phone has been saying "No Service" for the past few hours, and I’m not sure what to do. I mostly use it for calls and texts, so I’m a bit worried. Can you help me get it working again?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need anything else.
Yes, please go ahead and check. I just want to get my phone working again.
I’ve just completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to get my phone service restored?
I restarted my phone like you said, but it still shows "No Signal" at the top. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit worried—will I lose my photos if we keep doing this?

I can try to follow your instructions, but I get confused easily with technical stuff. If you could walk me through it slowly, I’ll do my best. Just to be clear, will any of these steps risk deleting my photos? That’s what I’m most worried about.
Okay, I’m ready. What do you need me to look for on the status bar? I see some icons at the top, but I’m not sure what they all mean.

At the top of my screen, I see an icon that looks like a circle with a line through it, and it says "No Signal." There’s also something about "Data Disabled," and my battery is at 80%. I don’t see an airplane icon or anything about Wi-Fi or network types like 4G or 5G. What should I do next?
I tried turning the mobile data on, but it still says "No Signal" and "Data Disabled" at the top. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to feel a bit frustrated—will this ever get fixed?
I checked the SIM card status, and it says there’s no SIM card detected in the phone. What does that mean? Is that bad? What should I do now?

I took out the SIM card and put it back in like you said. It looks like the phone now recognizes the SIM card, but I still see "No Signal" and "Data Disabled" at the top. Is there anything else we can try?
I checked, and my phone is set to "4G/5G preferred" for the network mode. Is that the right setting, or should I change it to something else?
I checked the status bar, and I don’t see an airplane icon, so I don’t think Airplane Mode is on. It still just says "No Signal" and "Data Disabled." What else can we try?
I checked the APN settings, and it says the APN name is "broken." Should I reset these settings to default, or is there something else I should do? I don’t really understand what APN means.

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone. Now I see signal bars at the top, and it says "5G" with "Excellent" signal strength! It still says "Data Disabled," but I think the main problem is fixed. Thank you so much for your help!

Thank you! I’m just relieved my phone can make calls and get texts again. I think I can manage turning on the mobile data if I need it. I really appreciate your patience and help walking me through everything—especially since I get so nervous with this stuff. Thanks again!
Thank you so much! You’ve been very kind and patient. Have a great day! ###STOP###

input_messages.content: Hi there. My phone has been saying "No Service" for the past few hours, and I’m not sure what to do. I mostly use it for calls and texts, so I’m a bit worried. Can you help me get it working again?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
I’ve just completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to get my service back?
Oh, I get a bit nervous about restarting my phone—will I lose any of my photos or messages if I do this? I really don’t want to lose anything important.
I restarted my phone like you said, but it still shows "No Signal" at the top. Is there something else I should try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated—will this get fixed soon?
I checked, and it says there’s no SIM card detected in the phone. What does that mean? Is something wrong with my phone?

I followed your instructions and took out the SIM card, then put it back in and turned the phone on again. But it still says "No Signal" at the top. Is there anything else I can try? I’m getting a bit worried now.

At the top of my screen, I see a little circle with a line through it (I think that means "No Signal"), and it also says "Data Disabled." The battery is at 80%. I don’t see anything about Airplane Mode. What should I do next?
I turned on the mobile data, but nothing changed—the top of the screen still shows "No Signal" and "Data Disabled." Is there something else I should try?
I checked, and my phone’s network mode is set to "4G/5G preferred." Is that the right setting, or should I change it to something else?
I checked the APN settings, and it says the APN name is "broken." I’m not sure what that means—should it say something else? I didn’t see any error messages, just that word.

I reset the APN settings and restarted my phone. Now at the top, I see full signal bars, it says "5G," and "Data Enabled." It looks like everything is working again! Thank you so much for your help and patience.
Thank you so much for your help and reassurance. I really appreciate you walking me through everything step by step. Have a wonderful day! ###STOP###

user_scenario.persona:
At 64 years old, you're a retired librarian who keeps your phone use simple - mainly for calls, texts, and capturing photos of your grandchildren. Technology in general makes you feel uneasy and overwhelmed.

Your technical knowledge is quite limited. Step-by-step instructions often confuse you, and technical terms like "VPN" or "APN" might as well be a foreign language. You only share information when specifically asked.

When dealing with technology, you tend to get flustered quickly. You need constant reassurance and often interrupt with anxious questions. Simple requests like "reboot the phone" can trigger worries about losing precious photos.
